WITH cand AS ( SELECT s.segment_id FROM segments s LEFT JOIN text_tier_segments t ON t.segment_id = s.segment_id WHERE s.purged_at IS NULL AND (t.segment_id IS NULL OR (t.written_at IS NULL AND t.claimed_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $2))) ORDER BY s.committed_at, s.segment_id LIMIT $1) INSERT INTO text_tier_segments (segment_id, claimed_at) SELECT segment_id, now() FROM cand ON CONFLICT (segment_id) DO UPDATE SET claimed_at = now() WHERE text_tier_segments.written_at IS NULL AND text_tier_segments.claimed_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $2) RETURNING segment_id

WITH cur AS ( SELECT r.kind, btrim(v.data->>'city') AS city, btrim(v.data->>'country') AS country FROM records r JOIN record_versions v ON v.record_id = r.record_id AND v.version = r.current_version WHERE r.state IN ('active', 'stale') AND coalesce(btrim(v.data->>'city'), '') <> '' AND coalesce(btrim(v.data->>'country'), '') <> ''), dest AS (SELECT city, country, city || ', ' || country AS name, count(*) AS n FROM cur GROUP BY city, country HAVING count(*) >= $1), have AS (SELECT city, country, kind, count(*) AS n FROM cur GROUP BY city, country, kind) SELECT d.name, k.kind FROM dest d CROSS JOIN unnest($3::text[]) AS k(kind) LEFT JOIN have h ON h.city = d.city AND h.country = d.country AND h.kind = k.kind WHERE coalesce(h.n, 0) < $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_candidates c WHERE c.destination = d.name AND k.kind = ANY(c.kinds) AND c.created_at > now() - make_interval(days => $5)) ORDER BY d.n DESC, coalesce(h.n, 0), d.name, k.kind LIMIT $4

WITH d AS (UPDATE llm_budget SET reserved = reserved + $3::bigint / 1000000.0 WHERE period = $1 AND spent + reserved + $3::bigint / 1000000.0 <= cap RETURNING 1), m AS (UPDATE llm_budget SET reserved = reserved + $3::bigint / 1000000.0 WHERE period = $2 AND spent + reserved + $3::bigint / 1000000.0 <= cap AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d) RETURNING 1), p AS (UPDATE llm_purpose_budget SET reserved = reserved + $3::bigint / 1000000.0 WHERE period = $2 AND purpose = $4 AND spent + reserved + $3::bigint / 1000000.0 <= cap AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m) RETURNING 1) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM p)

WITH done AS ( SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM captures WHERE url_key = $1 AND epoch = $3 AND role = 'primary') AS c) UPDATE url_state SET state = CASE WHEN done.c THEN 'due' ELSE 'fetched_pending' END, lease_epoch = CASE WHEN done.c THEN NULL ELSE lease_epoch END, pending_since = CASE WHEN done.c THEN NULL ELSE now() END, next_fetch_at = $4 FROM done WHERE url_key = $1 AND key = $2 AND lease_epoch = $3 AND state IN ('leased', 'fetched_pending')

WITH lease AS ( SELECT 1 FROM claims WHERE key = $1 AND epoch = $2 AND completed_at IS NULL AND deadline > now() ), tok AS ( UPDATE rate_bucket SET tokens = least($3, tokens + greatest(0, extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp() - updated_at)::float8) * $4) - 1, capacity = $3, refill_per_s = $4, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE name = 'global' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lease) AND least($3, tokens + greatest(0, extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp() - updated_at)::float8) * $4) >= 1 RETURNING 1 ), used AS ( UPDATE politeness_keys SET used_today = CASE WHEN budget_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date THEN 1 ELSE used_today + 1 END, budget_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date WHERE key = $1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tok) RETURNING 1 ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tok)

WITH live AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.record_id, r.place_ids, r.conflict FROM entity_claims c JOIN records r USING (record_id) WHERE c.entity_id = $1 AND r.state IN ('active', 'stale')) UPDATE entities e SET place_ids = coalesce((SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT p ORDER BY p) FROM live, unnest(live.place_ids) p), e.place_ids), conflict = coalesce((SELECT bool_or(conflict) FROM live), false), state = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live) THEN 'active' ELSE 'tombstoned' END, updated_at = now() WHERE e.entity_id = $1 RETURNING e.state, e.kind

WITH picked AS ( SELECT work_id FROM work_items WHERE kind = $1 AND ((state = 'ready' AND available_at <= now()) OR (state = 'leased' AND leased_until <= now() AND attempts < $4)) ORDER BY available_at, work_id LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE work_items w SET state = 'leased', attempts = w.attempts + 1, leased_until = now() + make_interval(secs => $3), updated_at = now() FROM picked WHERE w.work_id = picked.work_id RETURNING w.work_id, w.kind, w.payload, w.attempts, w.dedupe_key, w.created_at

WITH stale AS ( SELECT o.origin, o.key FROM origins o WHERE o.robots_expires_at < now() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM url_state d WHERE d.key = o.key AND d.state = 'due' AND d.next_fetch_at <= now() + interval '1 day') ORDER BY o.robots_expires_at LIMIT $1 ), pick AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.origin) u.url_key FROM stale s JOIN urls x ON x.key = s.key AND (x.url = s.origin OR x.url LIKE s.origin || '/%') JOIN url_state u ON u.url_key = x.url_key WHERE u.state = 'due' AND u.fetch_mode IN ('http', 'render') ORDER BY s.origin, u.next_fetch_at ) UPDATE url_state u SET next_fetch_at = now() FROM pick WHERE u.url_key = pick.url_key AND u.state = 'due'

WITH t AS ( SELECT * FROM unnest($1::bytea[], $2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::bytea[], $6::int2[], $7::real[], $8::timestamptz[], $9::text[], $10::text[]) AS t(url_key, url, key, source_id, discovered_from, depth, priority, not_before, fetch_mode, expect) ), ins AS ( INSERT INTO urls (url_key, url, key, source_id, discovered_from, depth) SELECT url_key, url, key, source_id, discovered_from, depth FROM t ON CONFLICT (url_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING url_key ) INSERT INTO url_state (url_key, key, priority, next_fetch_at, fetch_mode, expect, source_id, depth) SELECT t.url_key, t.key, t.priority, coalesce(t.not_before, now()), t.fetch_mode, t.expect, t.source_id, t.depth FROM t JOIN ins ON ins.url_key = t.url_key ON CONFLICT (url_key) DO NOTHING
